name: subprocessors-json
description: An open format for sub-processor lists. Parse, validate and diff subprocessors.json so any tool can watch any vendor.
author: Dekimu

scripts.check:schema-fresh: npm run build && cp subprocessors.schema.json $TMPDIR/s.json && npm run gen:schema && diff -q $TMPDIR/s.json subprocessors.schema.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run gen:schema && npm test
